venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Yesterday was 80 today it snowed, so not great
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 3/12.** Slower night. All reservations in by 8 (busiest point), then the floor slowed while the bar top stayed full of 2-tops with a round or two each. At 9:30 Jesse was sent home sick and the night finished with one bartender; server and kitchen cut soon after; a small push right before last call. Kitchen: ~8% of sales; all in-house popcorn cooked at the start of the shift; kitchen closed a little early ~10pm. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 3/12.** Busy-feeling Thursday with a full room from start to about midnight; author felt like a fish out of water adjusting to new systems; many enthusiastic fans and dates. Comps $220.88 (3.36%). Door: big shift from summer weather to wintry evening, still popping; many on the books at 6pm, 5 solos seated, pretty full by 7; full house by 8pm until 11:45, 2-3 groups on waitlist with waits under 30 min thanks to team help; empty by 1am; welcomed out-of-town members Carl Franklin and Layne Haber, Jane (neighbor) with mixologist friends, and Sergio Roman celebrating his wife's birthday (sent by DK). No-show: Justine Joseph for 2 @ 6pm (charged).
